title: k8s-pilot multi-cluster registry
description: Schema for config/clusters.yaml consumed by scripts/multi-cluster/*.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Currently pinned to 1; bump only with a coordinated wrapper update.

name.description: DNS-1123 label. The fan-out wrappers reference clusters by this name.

context.description: kubectl context name (the source of truth).

kubeconfig.description: Optional path to a non-default kubeconfig file.

tier.description: Environment tier. tier=prod is excluded from selector fan-out by default; include via explicit name= or -IncludeProd.
